author: SQLite Project
title: PRAGMA Statements
used_contract: Foreign-key setting changes during a pending transaction have no effect; CHECK enforcement can be disabled independently. Unknown PRAGMA names can be silently ignored, so readbacks and behavioral probes are required.
access_route: Official web text, no byte-identical snapshot archived

author: SQLite Project
title: SQLite Foreign Key Support
used_contract: Foreign-key enforcement depends on build support and connection settings; explicit settings and readbacks avoid dependence on defaults.

author: SQLite Project
title: CREATE TABLE
used_contract: Non-null duplicate UNIQUE values and zero-valued CHECK expressions violate constraints when enforcement applies. Each probe changes only the field relevant to one constraint.

author: SQLite Project
title: Result and Error Codes
used_contract: Extended constraint codes distinguish the expected rejection from an unrelated error.
